meta.name: to-tickets
meta.description: Break a plan, spec, or the current conversation into a set of tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blocking edges, published to the configured tracker (edges as text in one file per ticket locally, or native blocking links on a real tracker).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆解方案或讨论为带依赖的任务单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常把方案或讨论纪要变成任务清单
copy.tagline_en: Turn plans and specs into dependency-aware tickets automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn plans or specs into actionable task lists.

howto.what: 把计划、规格或当前对话拆成一组 tracer-bullet 工单（跨层的纵向切片），每个工单写明它被哪些工单阻塞；你确认拆分后，发布到已配置的追踪器——本地每单一个文件、阻塞边写成文本，或真实追踪器上的原生阻塞链接。
howto.when: 当你要求把计划、规格或当前对话拆成工单时触发；需先用 /setup-matt-pocock-skills 配置好追踪器。该技能不自动触发，需手动调用。

say.text: 把这个计划拆成一组带阻塞边的工单
say.note: 先给出编号清单供你确认，再发布

say.text: 把这个 issue 拆成 tracer-bullet 工单
say.note: 会先读取 issue 正文和评论

say.text: 把当前对话里的工作拆成工单并发布
say.note: 按依赖顺序发布，先发无阻塞的

howto.what_en: Turns a plan, spec or conversation into tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blockers. After you approve the list it publishes them to the configured tracker: one file per ticket locally, or native blocking links.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to break a plan, spec or the current conversation into tickets. Requires running /setup-matt-pocock-skills first to configure a tracker. Not model-invoked — call it yourself.

say_en.text: Break this plan into tickets with blocking edges
say_en.note: You review the numbered list before publishing

say_en.text: Break this issue into tracer-bullet tickets
say_en.note: Fetches the issue body and comments first

say_en.text: Turn the current conversation into tickets and publish them
say_en.note: Publishes blockers first, in dependency order
